AI insights

This report is based on sensor data from 2026-09-28 to 2026-10-04. Peak temperature was 23.8°C in Bed 3 on 2026-09-30 at 17:50, while the lowest was 18.1°C in Bed 2 on 2026-09-28 at 08:10. Humidity peaked at 73.7% in Ensuite on 2026-09-28 at 09:00, with the lowest at 49.4% in Lounge on 2026-10-01 at 12:50. The tightest condensation margin was 3.8°C in Loft 1, clear of the 3°C elevated-risk threshold. Against the CIBSE Guide A standard, targeting 21°C in living areas, 18°C in bedrooms, and 40-60% relative humidity, Landing was the best-performing room at 20.7°C and 58.3% humidity, close to its 21.0°C target, while Bed 3 was furthest from comfort at 21.9°C and 56.4% humidity, against its 18.0°C bedroom target. Daily mean temperatures rose from 20.2°C early in the week to a midweek peak of 22.3°C on 2026-10-01, then eased to 20.0°C by 2026-10-04. The most notable swing was a collective humidity drop around 2026-10-01 at 12:00 across Dining, Hall, Kitchen, and Lounge, with a largest change of -10.5%, consistent with windows opened for ventilation. Separately, Ensuite saw a sharp humidity rise of 14.3% between 08:30 and 09:00 on 2026-09-28, consistent with bathing activity.
